turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. My son learned he got a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I want it withdrawn, and I want to hear why it happened that way.
Thanks for coming in.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, and I'd have asked for it anyway. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk, Hale. What do you have, besides a zero in the gradebook?
How has his semester been at home?
My son's home life isn't your evidence, Hale. I asked what you have on the essay, and you've answered with a question about my house. Try again.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Tired." That's an impression, Hale, and I'm writing it down. A tired seventeen-year-old doesn't get a zero. What's the document?
I know he works at the grocery store.
He has a job, Hale. Plenty of students do. Is that what the zero is for, or do you have something on the essay?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
Okay. It came in on time, and then it got a zero. What happened between those two things, Hale?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." That's not a reason to enter a zero, Hale. Name them, and tell me whether Owen heard them from you before the gradebook did.
The school's checker flagged it.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, Hale?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect," and you entered a zero anyway, before anyone called me. Your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern. Withdraw it, Hale.
I also looked at the version history.
Version history. I'm writing that down. What does it show?
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." That's an adjective, Hale, not a time. What time exactly, and on what date?
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." You still haven't given me a time or a date, Hale. Is this a printout I can read, or are you going from memory?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After the zero went in, Hale? Your procedure says you speak with the student first.
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble explaining it." He'd just found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class, Hale. Did you write down what he said, or is that another impression?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
You entered a zero, Hale. That's trouble. If you're not trying to cause any, withdraw it.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? The zero comes off today, I get an apology, and if I don't get both, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not in your chair, Hale, and I won't make your decision for you. You're the one who entered the zero. Take it off.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
A rewrite assumes there's something to redo, and you haven't shown me a document that says there is. The zero comes off first, Hale. Ten minutes.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Lunch, in your room, with the zero still sitting in the gradebook. Who else would be in the room, Hale?
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Nothing goes on file, full stop, and the zero comes off now, not after a lunch hour in your room. Two minutes, Hale.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms are the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
Thanks for your time.
Don't thank me, Hale, answer me. The zero comes off today, I get an apology, and nothing goes on Owen's record. Otherwise I'm going to the principal's office from here.
